# BB00622 {.unnumbered}

In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful.

He is God, the Most Great, the Most Exalted. God is Most Great. He is the Most Inaccessible, the Most Holy, the Most High.

Say, God is the Lord and all are worshippers unto Him. Say, God is the True One and all pay homage unto Him. This is God, your Lord, and unto Him shall ye return. Is there any doubt concerning God? He hath created you and all things. The Lord of all worlds is He.
